48.original: Well, well, what have we here? I thought I knew all the prominent trades<hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D656EFF046D656E03> who pass through Solution Nine. Come to sign a contract, I trust?

49.original: You needn't fuss yourself over the details─the arrangement is blissfully simple. You provide me with product, and I compensate you for said product with scrips. A <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> of your expertise must surely recognize such a lucrative offer when they hear one.

50.original: In truth, it was the Turali who first introduced me to the many conveniences of trade with scrips. A system brought to them by a tradeswoman by the name of Rowena. But that is neither here nor there.

51.original: You will be well paid for your contributions─with scrips, naturally─and your earnings can in turn be used to purchase any of our wares that strike your fancy. So, what do you say?

52.original: Splendid! Simply splendid. And lest you worry, there will be no quotas to speak of. You need only make deliveries when inspiration strikes!

53.original: Here's to a most beautiful and profitable partnership! I very much look forward to doing business with you.

54.original: <sigh> What I wouldn't give for a capable trades<hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>. Now how am I to move all this merchandise?

55.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 90 or above.
